source: ADR 060 (docs/adr/060-a-plans-branch-merges-into-main-when-the-plan-pauses.md), Decision sections 2-4, approved by the product owner

changes.old: # Feature: merge-change lands an issue on its plan branch, and a plan on main only when it is done
changes.new: # Feature: merge-change lands an issue on its plan branch, and a plan on main whenever it pauses

changes.old: An issue in a plan merges into its plan's branch. A plan's branch merges into main only when every issue in the plan is closed, and only after every plan it needs has landed or been merged into it.
changes.new: An issue in a plan merges into its plan's branch. When the plan pauses, its branch merges into main once its review approves it, even with issues of the plan still open; those issues stay open and stay in the plan. Plan order does not hold a plan off main. When work on the plan starts again, a new branch is cut from main.

changes.old: - Goal: main gets a plan's work only when the plan is done.
changes.new: - Goal: main gets a plan's work whenever the plan pauses and its review approves it.

changes.old: - Fails if: a plan branch merges into main with an open issue, or before a plan it needs.
changes.new: - Fails if: a plan's branch is held off main for its open issues or for a plan it needs, or an issue in a plan lands on main instead of its plan's branch.

changes.old: - Checked by: a test plan with one open issue is refused on main; with all closed it lands.
changes.new: - Checked by: a test plan with one open issue lands on main once its review approves it, and that issue stays open.
